mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM mes_set_pollution_check WHERE deleted = 0 AND batch_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY batch_id ) pmb ON pmb.batch_id = s.batch_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT batch_no, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM mes_set_pollution_check WHERE deleted = 0 AND batch_id IS NULL AND batch_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY batch_no ) pmn ON s.batch_code IS NOT NULL AND pmn.batch_no = s.batch_code COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci LEFT JOIN mes_set_pollution_check p ON p.id = COALESCE(pmb.max_id, pmn.max_id)

FROM mes_wm_material_stock s LEFT JOIN mes_wm_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_md_item i ON i.id = s.item_id AND i.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN mes_md_item_type it ON it.id = s.item_type_id AND it.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_md_unit_measure u ON u.id = i.unit_measure_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_wm_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_wm_warehouse_location wl ON wl.id = s.location_id AND wl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_wm_warehouse_area wa ON wa.id = s.area_id AND wa.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN mes_pollution_ledger l ON l.source_check_id = p.id AND l.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.quantity <> 0

s.area_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_wm_material_stock s2 JOIN mes_wm_batch b2 ON b2.id = s2.batch_id AND b2.deleted = 0 WHERE s2.deleted = 0 AND s2.quantity <> 0 AND s2.area_id = s.area_id AND b2.pollution_status = 'POLLUTED' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_wm_material_stock s3 LEFT JOIN mes_wm_batch b3 ON b3.id = s3.batch_id AND b3.deleted = 0 WHERE s3.deleted = 0 AND s3.quantity <> 0 AND s3.area_id = s.area_id AND (b3.pollution_status IS NULL OR b3.pollution_status <> 'POLLUTED') )
(s.receipt_time IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.review_time, s.receipt_time) < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{reqVO.cycleDays} DAY))
(s.receipt_time IS NOT NULL AND s.receipt_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{reqVO.stockpileDays} DAY))
(p.id IS NULL) AS notChecked, AS overdue, AS stockpiled, () AS mixed
mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.item_type_id AS itemTypeId, s.item_id AS itemId, i.code AS itemCode, i.name AS itemName, i.specification AS specification, u.name AS unitMeasureName, s.batch_id AS batchId, s.batch_code AS batchCode, s.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.name AS warehouseName, s.location_id AS locationId, wl.name AS locationName, s.area_id AS areaId, wa.name AS areaName, wa.pollution_control AS areaPollutionControl, s.quantity AS quantity, s.receipt_time AS receiptTime, DATEDIFF(NOW(), s.receipt_time) AS stockDays, s.frozen AS frozen, b.pollution_status AS pollutionStatus, b.pollution_location AS pollutionLocation, b.pollution_marked AS pollutionMarked, b.pollution_src_record AS pollutionSrcRecord, p.id AS checkId, p.record_no AS checkRecordNo, p.ai_result AS aiResult, p.ai_confidence AS aiConfidence, p.review_result AS reviewResult, p.review_time AS reviewTime, p.disposition AS disposition, p.location AS checkLocation, p.location_id AS checkLocationId, p.marked AS checkMarked, l.id AS ledgerId, l.marked AS ledgerMarked,
CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (pmb.max_id IS NULL) END AS checkByBatchNo,
AND s.batch_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.batchCode}, '%')
AND (i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.itemName}, '%') OR i.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.itemName}, '%'))
AND s.item_type_id IN #{typeId}
AND s.warehouse_id = #{reqVO.warehouseId}
AND b.pollution_status = 'POLLUTED'
AND b.pollution_status IS NOT NULL AND b.pollution_status <> 'POLLUTED'
AND b.pollution_status IS NULL
AND s.receipt_time IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), s.receipt_time) > #{reqVO.minStockDays}
AND
AND p.id IS NOT NULL
AND p.id IS NULL
AND
AND
AND (p.id IS NULL OR OR OR () )
ORDER BY s.receipt_time ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS stockRows, COUNT(DISTINCT s.batch_id) AS batchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.review_result IS NOT NULL THEN s.batch_id END) AS coveredBatchCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.review_result = 'POLLUTED' THEN s.batch_id END) AS pollutedBatchCount, COALESCE(SUM(p.id IS NULL), 0) AS notChecked, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS overdue, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS stockpiled, COALESCE(SUM(), 0) AS mixed,
COALESCE(SUM(b.pollution_status = 'POLLUTED'), 0) AS pollutedRows,
COALESCE(SUM(p.id IS NULL OR OR OR () ), 0) AS pending

SELECT s.warehouse_id AS dimId, w.name AS dimName,
GROUP BY s.warehouse_id, w.name ORDER BY stockRows DESC

SELECT s.item_type_id AS dimId, it.name AS dimName,
GROUP BY s.item_type_id, it.name ORDER BY stockRows DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(MAX(DATEDIFF(NOW(), create_time)), 0) AS maxWaitDays FROM mes_set_pollution_check WHERE deleted = 0 AND review_result IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS closedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, create_time, status_time))), 0) AS avgDays, COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, create_time, status_time)), 0) AS maxDays FROM mes_pollution_ledger WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> 'STORED' AND status_time IS NOT NULL
